documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Discussion And Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended Sep 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Uniparts India Limited reported Q1 FY27 revenue from operations of INR 347 crores, marking a 27% year-on-year growth, alongside EBITDA of INR 90 crores and PAT of INR 57 crores. Construction equipment performance was strong and contributed 45% of total revenue, while large agriculture equipment remained subdued at a cyclical bottom. Management raised its outlook for FY27, expecting revenue growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than FY26. The company maintained a strong balance sheet with INR 190 crores in net cash and continues to actively evaluate inorganic acquisition opportunities. Uniparts India reported a 27% year-on-year revenue growth for Q1 FY27, with total income reaching INR 3,552 Mn, EBITDA at INR 898 Mn, and PAT at INR 566 Mn.

guidance.claim: Q1 FY27 revenue from operations was INR 347 crores, growing 27% year-over-year and remaining broadly in line with guidance.
guidance.quote: Our revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 stood at INR347 crores, representing 27% year-over-year growth and remaining broadly in line with the guidance we had shared earlier.

guidance.claim: Management expects FY27 top-line growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than FY26 growth on a year-on-year basis.
guidance.quote: And keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q2 FY27 performance to be in line with Q1 FY27.
guidance.quote: So Q2 looks very robust, and I think Q2 should be in line with Q1.

guidance.claim: Management expects FY27 revenue from the Mexico business to be in the mid-single-digit million dollar range.
guidance.quote: For FY27, we believe that this revenue should be in mid-single-digit million dollar level.

guidance.claim: Management stated that Q1 FY27 performance aligned with quarter-on-quarter guidance and exceeded annual guidance.
guidance.quote: This performance is in line with the quarter on quarter guidance we had shared but better than the annual guidance we had given, and reflects the quality of execution by the team across a quarter that was not without its challenges.

guidance.claim: Uniparts expects FY27 revenue growth to be in line with the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q1 FY27 to be in line with Q4 FY26 and H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1 FY27.
guidance.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4. And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

guidance.claim: The company expects to operate comfortably above a 20% EBITDA margin level as volumes build through FY27.
guidance.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle. And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction equipment momentum from second half of CY2025 continued into Q1 FY27, driven by US technology investments and European government spending.
demand_outlook.quote: On the construction equipment, the momentum that started in the second half of calendar year 2025 has continued into Q1 of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs indicate that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom for large agricultural equipment, with recovery expected in CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agricultural equipment in India performs well supported by subsidy programs, while Western markets are showing early signs of unit volume recovery.
demand_outlook.quote: In the small agriculture equipment, India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket business accounted for approximately 12% of Q1 FY27 revenue and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.
demand_outlook.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending in the US and Europe is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility in construction equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Unit volumes in the Western small agriculture segment are beginning to recover after three consecutive years of volume declines.
demand_outlook.quote: That said, the bottom appears to be behind us; after three consecutive years of volume declines, we are beginning to see some recovery in unit volumes, and the direction of growth is encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs indicate that CY2026 marks the cyclical bottom for large agriculture, with recovery expected through CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the aftermarket segment to normalize and return to growth as tariffs have decreased.
demand_outlook.quote: With tariffs having since come down, we expect this to normalise and the segment to return to growth.

demand_outlook.claim: North America construction equipment demand is expected to strengthen gradually through FY27 with H2 being better than H1.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture segment in North America is expected to grow by approximately 5% in FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry volumes for large tractors in North America continue to decline in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America and particularly, the industry volumes for large tractors continues to track down in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.

capex_expansion.claim: Restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing on schedule with uninterrupted customer supply.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track with first customer warehouse deliveries expected in Q3 of this year.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during Q1 FY27 stood at INR 12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex plans remain unchanged at 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for Q4 FY26 stood at INR 12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA reached INR 90 crores, showing a 55% year-on-year growth and 10% sequential growth.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: Material costs stood at 33.3% in Q1 FY27 mainly due to product mix changes, alongside a small inventory gain of roughly INR 1 crore.
margins_costs.quote: There has been a small inventory gain that you will see on the face of the financials, and that's roughly about INR1 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Management maintains that baseline material costs typically range from 34% to 37%.
margins_costs.quote: I think what we've always maintained is that our material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%, and that's typical of our business.

margins_costs.claim: The West Asia situation continues to put pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: The company recorded an EBITDA margin of 25.3% in Q1 FY27.
Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% in Q4 FY26 and 22% for full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability was impacted by INR 3.4 crores due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.
margins_costs.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

margins_costs.claim: Material cost stood at 35% in Q4 FY26, returning to its normal range of 34% to 37%.
margins_costs.quote: Now when we look at quarter 4 and let's understand the results of quarter 4, our material cost of 35% has now come back to where we've always said our normal material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month new business order book stands at over INR 225 crores across three product platforms.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Construction equipment segment currently contributes 45% of total company revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: Ashutosh, you are right that in Q1 FY27, the business has really seen a good growth in the construction business, which is today 45% of our total revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: Warehousing sales represented approximately 56% of revenue in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: In Q1 FY27, our warehousing sales was roughly at about 56%.

orders_capacity.claim: Uniparts India's trailing twelve-month new business order book stands at over INR 225 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore, with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Large agriculture represents close to 20% of Uniparts' business at the end of FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: And what is the share of large ag in our business at the end of FY26, it's close to 20%.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash generated during Q1 FY27 was INR 44 crores, leading to a net cash position of approximately INR 190 crores at quarter-end.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated INR44 crores of operating cash during the quarter, and our 12-month trailing EPS stands at INR39.97, reflecting sustained improvement in earnings over the past year.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital was 139 days of trailing 12-month revenue as of June 30.
capital_allocation.quote: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of 30th June, reflecting our near-shoring and warehousing-led business model while remaining broadly under control.

capital_allocation.claim: Management is evaluating about half a dozen acquisition opportunities in PTOs, hydraulics, and fabrications.
capital_allocation.quote: I think today, we have about half a dozen opportunities that we are closely looking at.

capital_allocation.claim: The net cash position stood at INR 190 crore at the end of Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Management continues to actively evaluate potential acquisition opportunities.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts is net debt free with a net cash position of INR 160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR 170 crores, including a special dividend of INR 101 crores in Q3 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores. In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation continues to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility and inflation caused customers and channel partners to moderate purchasing in the replacement market.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management expects a mid-teens market decline in the large agricultural equipment industry in the current year.
risks_headwinds.quote: We expect mid-teens decline in the large ag industry this year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Price volatility driven by tariffs caused customers and channel partners to moderate purchasing in the aftermarket segment.
risks_headwinds.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fire incident occurred at the Ludhiana finishing shop facility during Q3 FY26 and is fully covered under insurance.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fresh escalation in West Asia in March introduced supply chain uncertainty and increased input prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3 of this year.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects FY27 growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than FY26 growth on a year-on-year basis.
management_commitments.quote: And keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the fabrication vertical to become meaningful in the next 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse operations are expected in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: Uniparts expects FY27 revenue growth to be in line with FY26 growth.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects H2 FY27 to perform better than H1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4. And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

management_commitments.claim: Capex will be maintained consistently in the range of 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
management_commitments.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
